entries.10c9567ab2653e5d: A single-segment business that manufactures and sells signage products used on the interior and exterior of buildings. Mainly custom-made, one-off production to customer requests, with stainless steel as the main material. Manufacturing is carried out at the head office factory in Asakita Ward, Hiroshima City and at the Nakafukagawa Plant. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,411 million.
entries.3415933a5291a421: A company headquartered in Hiroshima City that makes and sells sign products, mainly metal ones, used inside and outside buildings, produced on a made-to-order basis.
entries.36728bd2ec95cef8: Signboards, nameplates and other signage products made by processing metals such as stainless steel.
entries.c06730a8be011011: These are signage products made of resin. The medium-term management plan sets out securing market competitiveness.
